Stationary Engineers and boiler operators start up, regulate, repair, and shut down equipment. They monitor meters, gauges, and computerized controls to ensure that equipment operates safely and within established limits. They use sophisticated electrical and electronic test equipment to service, troubleshoot, repair, and monitor heating, cooling, and ventilation systems. Stationary engineers and boiler operators also perform routine maintenance. They may completely overhaul or replace defective valves, gaskets, or bearings. In addition, they lubricate moving parts, replace filters, and remove soot and corrosion that can make a boiler less efficient. jobs.description_text: The Cesium software team is looking for Summer 2026 interns to design embedded software for satellite communication systems. Embedded software development interns will work closely with Cesium engineers on low-level and high-level software in Cesium’s space electronics products. Areas of focus will include microcontroller programming, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and the interests of the successful candidates. Cesium interns regularly present their work to peers, mentors, and Cesium executive leadership throughout the course of the summer. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. To apply, please include a cover letter describing your interest in embedded software development and either space systems or communication systems. We are accepting applications for this role through October 10th,2025.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 - Systems Engineering Internship
jobs.description_text: As a Systems Engineering Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to contribute to the success of our projects. You will support the design and verification of real-world space systems, collaborating closely with electrical, mechanical, software, RF, and test teams. Tasks may include requirements development, interface definition, system-level analysis, trade studies, integration planning, and test execution. Specific assignments will be matched based on your interests and active program needs. If you're passionate about multidisciplinary engineering and space systems—and want to be involved in defining how complex hardware and software come together into a unified system—this role is for you.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 – Power Electronics Internship
jobs.description_text: The Analog & Power Electronics team is responsible for developing advanced power electronics for our space and military products. We own analog and power electronics designs for multi-output power supply modules and for point of load (PoL) power supplies for RF and Digital boards. We are responsible for the entire development cycle from power architecture development to part selection, schematic and printed circuit board (PCB) design, verification testing, and production release. Designs encompass the entire spectrum of power supply development including power conversion, power management and control, fault management, and power filtering for low noise and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). We’re looking for summer interns to support our mission. Interns work side-by-side with experienced power electronics engineers. Interns in the Analog & Power team are typically responsible for design projects that directly contribute towards an on-going program or contribute towards advancing the Analog & Power Electronics team’s technology development road map. Interns will also gain valuable experience in hands-on laboratory characterization and troubleshooting of power electronics. To apply, please include a brief cover letter describing your interest in power or analog electronics hardware design.

jobs.title: Supervisor Quality Control
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Supervisor, Quality Control to our team. In this role you will monitor daily inspection and quality control activities to ensure hardware meets engineering specifications, customer requirements, and established aerospace quality standards. This role assigns inspection work, coordinates personnel and resources, monitors productivity, and reviews inspection results and documentation for accuracy and completeness. The Supervisor addresses routine product quality concerns, maintains established inspection procedures, and supports consistent product acceptance and manufacturing operations. This position requires an experienced quality control professional with practical knowledge of inspection methods, product acceptance, nonconformance control, and quality management systems. Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, and Quality Assurance, the Supervisor coordinates inspection priorities, communicates quality concerns, and supports resolution of issues affecting daily workflow, production schedules, and product conformity.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer II
jobs.description_text: The Skylark product line is focused on the rapid design, build, and test of cutting-edge active phased array antennas (AESA) for terrestrial and airborne applications. Current programs span high-power, large-scale ground terminals for missile defense to commercial airline and helicopter connectivity solutions. We are looking to add a Systems Engineer II to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased arrays for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for leading the systems engineering activities required to define, develop, integrate, verify, and support complex aerospace systems throughout the product lifecycle. This role translates mission objectives, customer requirements, and system architecture into technical solutions that enable successful system integration and mission execution. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, the Senior Systems Engineer collaborates with software, hardware, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, integration and test, mission operations, and program management teams to ensure systems meet technical, operational, cost, and schedule objectives. This role provides technical leadership from concept development through design, integration, verification, launch, and operational support while contributing to technical decision-making and risk management.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Talent Acquisition Partner to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about hiring top talent to work on satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for building a pipeline of candidates to help develop leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems. You will collaborate with hiring managers and key stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top talent in various disciplines within the aerospace industry. This is a multifaceted job that requires strong technical aptitude and the ability to effectively assess the technical capabilities of candidates, along with outstanding organizational skills and the ability to understand and promote the value proposition Cesium offers. Talent acquisition activities will include sourcing candidates from a variety of platforms and helping to develop high-impact recruiting strategies. You will work closely with Cesium engineering and business staff to develop and execute talent acquisition projects.

jobs.title: Test Technician II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Test Technician II to our team. If you are excited about working in a startup environment, have a strong work ethic, and are passionate about cutting-edge electronics, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will work closely with CesiumAstro engineers to create module & payload performance test setups, execute test plans, and produce timely, reliable test results. You will have the opportunity to use and maintain state-of-the-art electronics lab instrumentation, such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, automated power supplies, and more. You will be challenged to propose and fabricate intricate test setups to increase productivity and improve test results. Many of our products include active phased arrays (a.k.a. active electronically scanned arrays, or AESAs). These are antenna products with active RF circuitry integrated with the antenna. This adds complexity to the test architecture, including power, digital control, and thermal effects. As such, direct experience with phased array (or AESA) testing is preferred. Core day-to-day activities will include aligning with engineers to test and troubleshoot complex electronics and RF circuitry from component level to system level. As such, the ability to understand and work from drawings, diagrams, schematics, and test procedures is key. As a small company, the CesiumAstro team “wears many hats.” Candidates should be comfortable with a varied workflow that may involve multitasking between test setu

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Administrator II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Trade Compliance Administrator II to our team. In this role you will perform trade compliance activities involving export licensing, regulatory classifications, technology transfers, and compliance documentation across aerospace and defense products and business operations. This role applies established trade compliance procedures to review export transactions, assess routine authorization requirements, conduct regulatory screening, and maintain accurate compliance records. Through execution of assigned activities, the Trade Compliance Administrator II supports regulatory compliance, accurate documentation, and effective management of export-controlled transactions. Working cross-functionally with Engineering, Supply Chain, Contracts, Legal, Manufacturing, Program Management, Human Resources, and Security, this role supports export authorization activities, regulatory compliance reviews, documentation requirements, and routine issue resolution that contribute to compliant business operations.

jobs.title: Vice President of Business Development (Commercial)
jobs.location_raw: Westminster, CO · El Segundo, CA · Austin, TX
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Vice President of Business Development (Commercial) to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment, and have a mind for the business of technology, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for marketing, sales, and developing business opportunities and relationships with potential CesiumAstro customers. The area of responsibility for this role is broad and requires a wide range of knowledge about the space industry, telecommunication and RF electronic products, technology commercialization, market analysis, relationship management, and strategic planning. Daily responsibilities include developing and continuously updating the commercial and DOD aerospace telecommunication electronics market potential and trends, identifying opportunities, writing and submitting RFI and RFP responses, visiting existing and potential customers, interfacing with engineering and product development staff to articulate market gaps and demands, assisting in the strategic and R&D roadmaps for the company, and ultimately leading the top line revenue growth for the company. The successful candidate will be highly experienced in aerospace electronics sales and marketing, particularly RF and telecommunications equipment. The ideal candidate is extremely organized, articulate, flexible, quick to grasp business needs, a team player, an excellent written and oral communicator, and eager to learn.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Facilities
jobs.description_text: Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

jobs.title: Wire Harness Design Engineer II
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Wire Harness Design Engineer II to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. This role focuses on designing the critical power, digital, analog, and RF interconnects that turn boxes into systems. You will have the opportunity to take full ownership of wire harness designs, including schematic development, cable routing, connector selection, and harness assembly drawings. The environment is highly collaborative, working shoulder-to-shoulder with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, and harness assembly technicians to develop cutting-edge space and airborne systems. The role encompasses the full design process, from defining initial specifications through integration and test. You will also participate in design reviews, providing technical expertise and recommendations to enhance the performance and reliability of wire harness systems.

jobs.title: Buyer / Supply Chain & Logistics Spring Intern (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Buyer / Supply Chain & Logistics Intern to join our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. Every P3 module is built from thousands of parts: steel, optics, insulation, valves, motors and power electronics, sourced from suppliers across the U.S. and around the world. You'll help get the right parts to our factory floor on time and at the right cost. This is a hands-on internship. You'll place real purchase orders, work directly with suppliers and freight carriers, and see the parts you buy become hardware that ships to customer sites.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager (Austin, TX)
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Global Supply Manager with exceptional negotiation skills to establish and manage commercial relationships with contract manufacturers and strategic partners. In this role, you will own cost negotiations, supply planning, and risk management while driving cost reduction through operational efficiency and disciplined processes. You will be instrumental in executing projects that meet both product milestones and corporate goals. This role sits at the intersection of internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners, requiring someone who can balance competing priorities to ensure successful product launches. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-moving environment, drives excellence across their own responsibilities and those of team members and partners, and communicates concisely and effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional peers alike. This employee will be based in Austin, TX, and will also work from our Miami headquarters as needed. Relocation to Austin, TX is required, and relocation assistance will be provided.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager MBA Spring Intern (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Global Supply Manager MBA Intern to join our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. You'll work alongside our Global Supply Managers on the commercial side of building P3: choosing contract manufacturers and suppliers, negotiating cost, planning supply and managing risk as we move from first units toward volume production. This is a strategic internship with real stakes. You'll own a sourcing project from analysis to recommendation, sit in on supplier negotiations, and present your findings to Supply Chain & Manufacturing leadership.

jobs.title: Lead Materials Engineer (Miami, FL)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking an exceptional Lead Materials Engineer with deep research expertise to spearhead materials innovation for our revolutionary thermal energy storage technology. This role demands a PhD-level researcher who thrives on solving complex, multi-physics materials challenges that push the boundaries of what's possible in renewable energy. This position is based in Miami, FL. If selected, relocation to Miami, FL is required. Exowatt provides relocation assistance.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer (Austin, TX)
jobs.description_text: We're hiring a Quality Engineer to own the quality of our supply chain and manufacturing operations. You'll qualify suppliers, drive root-cause investigations, and build the quality systems that let us scale from pilot builds to volume production. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone equally at home on a factory floor, at a supplier site, and deep in inspection and yield data. This role is based in our Austin, TX facility. Relocation is required, and relocation assistance will be provided if necessary.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (Austin, TX)
jobs.description_text: We're hiring a Reliability Engineer to own the long-term dependability of the P3 system in the field. You'll define reliability requirements, run life-test programs, analyze field failure data, and ensure every unit we ship meets the demanding uptime expectations of AI infrastructure customers. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone equally at home in a test lab, at a customer site, and deep in failure data. This role is based in our Austin, TX facility. Relocation is required, and relocation assistance will be provided if necessary.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Austin, TX)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to contribute to the design and development of the electrical systems that make our technology work from power conversion and controls to instrumentation and grid interconnection. This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on technical execution. You'll own discrete electrical designs and sub-systems, work closely with senior engineers on broader architecture decisions, and partner across mechanical, controls, and systems teams to bring our product to life. This role is based at our facility in Austin, TX. If selected for the role relocation is required, and relocation assistance will be provided.

jobs.title: Supply Chain & Manufacturing Spring Intern - Manufacturing (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Supply Chain & Manufacturing Intern – Manufacturing to join our team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. You'll work directly with our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team on the processes that bring P3 modules to life. Your work will span the factory floor and the supply base: developing how P3 modules are assembled, and helping negotiate with the suppliers who keep materials flowing. You'll see end to end how a hardware company scales from early units to volume production.

jobs.title: Controls Engineering Co-Op
jobs.description_text: Position Summary: The Controls and Commissioning Co-op is part of a cross-discipline project team, supporting the successful execution of conveyor system integration projects. Under the guidance of experienced controls engineers, the co-op will assist with electrical controls engineering, PLC programming, testing, documentation, and commissioning activities while gaining hands-on experience in industrial automation and material handling systems. The Controls and Commissioning Co-op will aid in the testing, implementation, and commissioning of PLC programs used to control conveyor systems and related equipment within the Material Handling Industry. This includes participating in system testing, assisting with field commissioning activities, and helping ensure compliance with customer specifications and project requirements. The position provides valuable exposure to PLs, industrial networking, HMI systems, electrical design, troubleshooting, and field commissioning while working alongside experienced Controls Engineers. Tasks Review electrical drawings, I/O lists, control narratives, and system documentation. Participate in system testing and validation efforts to ensure compliance with design requirements. Assist with completion of testing and commissioning documentation. Support field commissioning and startup activities for assigned projects. Aid in troubleshooting PLC programs, HMIs, industrial communication networks, and field devices. Travel to customer sites to support

jobs.title: Hardware Engineering Co-Op
jobs.description_text: Join Our Hardware Engineering Team as a Co-op! Are you a budding electrical engineering enthusiast looking to dive into the world of hardware engineering? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to gain hands-on experience and expand your skills in our dynamic team! Position: Hardware Engineering Co-op Location: Louisville, KY (On-site) Hours: 40 hours per week About Us: At Diversified Automation, we pride ourselves on innovation and cutting-edge technology. Our hardware engineering department is at the forefront of our operations. As a co-op member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to learn from seasoned professionals and contribute to real-world projects that make a difference. Responsibilities: - Collaborate with our experienced engineers to revise and update hardware architectural drawings. - Assist in the creation of new hardware architectural drawings using AutoCAD software. - Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute innovative ideas to ongoing projects. - Conduct research and analysis to support hardware design decisions. - Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware components. Requirements: - Enrolled in an accredited university pursuing a degree in electrical engineering. - Proficiency in AutoCAD software or willingness to learn. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. - Ability to work on-site at our Louisville office for the specified hours.

jobs.title: Purchasing Agent
jobs.description_text: As a Purchasing Agent at Diversified Automation, you play a key role in cross-functional project teams, contributing to the successful execution of automation solutions. You bring a deep understanding of the materials and services required to support each project, and you collaborate closely with vendors and subcontractors to ensure that pricing aligns with budget constraints and lead times integrate seamlessly with project schedules. Your role goes beyond procurement—you actively build and maintain strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, suppliers and subcontractors. These partnerships help us assess capabilities, ensure quality and reliability, and foster long-term collaboration that supports our growth and innovation in the automation industry. Tasks: Accurately prepare and manage purchase orders, ensuring alignment with project BOMs and budget requirements. Monitor supplier performance and proactively communicate any delays or procurement-related issues to Operations. Oversee the end-to-end flow of materials—from initial demand through to receipt—ensuring timely and accurate delivery to support project execution. Track and communicate lead times, proactively coordinating with internal teams to maintain project schedules. Proactively identify and address component shortages, mitigating risks to panel builds and project timelines. Procure materials and services through Diversified Automation systems, including subcontracts and purchase orders. Serve as a key con

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description_text: Job Description The Account Managers are responsible for working directly with our customers to ensure full, continuous satisfaction with our solutions and services are met. The Account Manager’s ultimate goals are to drive customer engagement and readiness of our solutions in times of crisis. Their engagement activities are responsible for building strong customer relationships that promote customer retention as well as ensuring customers are aware of opportunities to better complete their unified notification solutions with simple, easy-to-deploy automated crisis response tools they may not yet have. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills. They will need a strong technical understanding of our products’ current capabilities and the drive to find out more about our customers’ needs to ensure that our solutions are meeting their expectations to the fullest. Travel to our Baltimore HQ is required for onboarding, trainings, and other in-person team/company activities. Candidates must be located in the Baltimore, MD area and/or within driving distance to our headquarters.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description_text: Job Description Most design roles focus on a single feature or a specific interface. This is different. As a SeniorUX Designer here, you are a core architect of the "Whole Product" experience and the primary steward of our visual identity within our software. You won’t just be refining pixels; you will be sitting at the intersection of brand strategy, product vision, and technical feasibility. Working directly with our Product Development team, you will ensure our digital solutions are not only functional but are cohesive and easy to use. Your mission is to ensure that as our technical capabilities scale, our user experience remains intuitive, unified, and aligned with our brand. Candidates must be located within driving distance from our Baltimore HQ.

jobs.title: Technical Support Analyst II (Hardware & Field Service)
jobs.description_text: Job Description We are looking for a motivated troubleshooter to play a critical role in driving Alertus' rapid growth. Reporting to the Technical Support Manager, the Technical Support Analyst II role combines remote technical assistance with on-site deployment and hardware troubleshooting, serving as a key resource for customer project startups, field diagnostics, and hardware replacement. Our ideal candidate is a technical, versatile problem-solver with a strong desire to always provide the best and most efficient customer service. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites (up to 50%), with occasional adjustment of work hours to support project schedules. *This is an office-based role when not traveling to customer sites.

jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern, AI Molecular Design (Winter/Spring)
jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is an AI for Science company on a mission to make biology fully computable. We are building AIDO (AI-Driven Digital Organism) to simulate living systems, decode biology holistically, and accelerate medical and scientific research. Our first step toward that mission is AIDO Cell, the first virtual cell world model that holistically simulates cell biology from molecules up to whole-cell behavior. It enables researchers to run experiments virtually, predicting how cells respond to genetic changes, drugs and other interventions before going into the lab. It is supported by AIDO Foundry, an AI-builds-AI engineering framework for automating virtual cell development, and AIDO Lab, an interface to digitally run experiments and observe the results. Together they form the foundation for a new paradigm in AI-driven drug discovery, bioengineering, and fundamental biomedical research.

As a key member of the team, the Communications Lead will coordinate communications and outreach with the communities in which SpaceX operates, work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to support key initiatives, and develop communication strategies that get the public excited about how artificial intelligence will help and support SpaceX and its affiliates' positions as a positive impact in the community. A successful candidate is passionate about our mission, a strategic thinker with a can-do attitude, and a natural verbal and written communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where no problem is too great and no detail too small. This position will work out of SpaceX’s Starbase site in Louisiana, with the possibility of travelling in support of other SpaceX facilities or other events. RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide tactical public relations support, including logistical planning and execution, and maintain successful relationships with a portfolio of key community partners and stakeholders. Develop communication strategies that will generate public excitement about SpaceX and its affiliates’ mission and its positive impact on surrounding communities. jobs.title: Composites Technician (COPV)
jobs.description_text: COMPOSITES TECHNICIAN (COPV) The Starship COPV Composites Technician manufactures flight-critical composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) used to store high-pressure gases on Starship and Super Heavy. This is a hands-on production role: preparing metallic liners, filament-winding the composite overwrap, curing, and trimming, finishing, and assembling COPV hardware to engineering drawings and process specifications. This position is onsite at a SpaceX production facility supporting Starship COPV manufacturing. The successful candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working from travelers and work instructions, and able to produce consistent, high-quality composite work in a fast-paced flight-hardware environment. RESPONSIBILITIES: Prepare metallic COPV liners and bond interfaces for overwrap, including grit blast, hand abrasion, and power abrasion Manufacture COPVs by filament winding composite fiber onto liners, including hoop and helical winding patterns, fiber tension, and resin application (wet winding and/or towpreg) Set up, operate, and tend filament winding equipment; load liners, verify winding programs, and monitor fiber path, bandwidth, and resin wet-out during the wrap Mix, handle, and apply resins and adhesives per process specification, including pot life, mix ratio, and material traceability Cure COPV overwraps and bonded assemblies in ovens or autoclaves, including thermocouple placement and process monitoring Trim and finish composite and composite-meta

jobs.title: Construction Safety Engineer
jobs.description_text: CONSTRUCTION SAFETY ENGINEER As part of a team of technicians and engineers, you will provide technical expertise and assist in the implementation of all Environmental, Health and Safety programs at the McGregor, TX rocket-engine test site. The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both environmental and occupational safety, is hands-on in a high-energy test environment, and can manage contractor and contingent-labor EHS with the same rigor as employee programs. We work as a highly integrated team and job responsibilities will include helping other programs to ensure the overall success of SpaceX. RESPONSIBILITIES: Work closely with test engineers, stand crews, and technician teams to perform detailed safety reviews of complex hazardous operations (hot fire, propellant loading, pressurization, ordnance, cryogenics, and post-test recovery) to ensure safe execution. Lead or assist in all aspects of incident investigations, including initial follow-up, root cause analysis, and corrective action development and closure; enter events in Safety Net and drive closure with operations leadership. Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures for Merlin, Raptor, fabrication, civil/construction, and support shops.
